title: Dina Beg’s Secret Petition to Jassa Singh

blocks.text: Alarmed by the scale of the Sikh advance, Dina Beg looks for a way to save Jalandhar without openly breaking faith with Wadbhag Singh. He sends a secret petition to Jassa Singh, hoping the leading Sikh chief can restrain the sack in return for money and preserve the city under a negotiated settlement.

The appeal reaches the Khalsa assembly, but Wadbhag Singh answers from a position of strength and insists that the old Pathan offenses must first be avenged. His challenge stiffens the whole gathering, and Dina Beg learns that payment alone will not override the moral claims already made in the name of the Panth.

Only by humbling himself further can he keep the situation from spinning beyond his control. The page captures the moment when back-channel diplomacy, public Khalsa resolve, and personal authority all collide around the fate of Jalandhar.
